newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JUNE 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JUNE 18.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the June 19 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The system of tax collection for oil companies will be changed in the near future.
- World aluminium prices are likely to rise due to events taking place at Russia's Krasnoyarsk aluminium plant.
- Some large state budget debtors will have their debts restructured in exchange for a controlling package of shares, according to the state commision on current economic issues.
- A final decision on a deal between France's Renaut and the biggest Moscow car producer is to be announced soon.
- Sverdlovsk region in the Urals is planning to issue bonds to raise about $300 million.
- The European Union's policy towards Russia seems strange in connection with the country's successful privatisation.
- Former Russian Defence Minister Pavel Grachev is likely to represent Russia at its mission to NATO.
